title: My New Post
text:
To start work on my project, I did a few things to show off my analysis and data skills. First, I found some data online and imported it into a database schema. 
As I work further on this, I will improve the organization of the data, to structure it appropriately and effeciently.
Then, I imported it into r and did prelimenary analysis, looking for useful insights.
